SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Macramé, part of Indigenous Crafts (3D Art) in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 FINE ARTS FOR LEARNERS WITH LOW VISION JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How can macramé be used to make wall hangings? 2. How does choice of knots influence the appearance of macramé’ item?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Macramé together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: The skill of sharing learnt knowledge is promoted as the learner acquires new skill to make items

using macramé.

• Creativity and imagination: The skill of making observation is developed as the learner construct a two-coloured

ornamental wall hanging with lose and tight macramé webs.

Values

• Integrity: Learner utilizes resources sparingly and avoids conflict of interest during critique sessions.

• Respect: Learner gives feedback to peers on their work in a just manner.
